findings.claim: The migration indexes execute(...)[0]['id'] for the embed_category lookup without checking for an empty result. It raises IndexError when no matching site_settings row exists, such as on fresh installs or the test DB.

verifier.reason: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:9-11, the migration directly indexes execute(...)[0]['id'] on the PG::Result returned by the PostgreSQL adapter without checking whether any rows were returned (unlike the cmd_tuples > 0 guard used on lines 18-20). When no matching embed_category row exists in site_settings (such as on fresh installs, test databases, or sites without a customized embed_category), PG::Result#[0] raises IndexError.

findings.claim: The migration backfill interpolates legacy host strings directly into raw SQL (VALUES ('#{h}', ...)) without quoting or parameter binding. A value containing a single quote aborts the migration.

verifier.reason: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:20-25, each line h split from the legacy embeddable_hosts site_settings value is interpolated directly into raw SQL as VALUES ('#{h}', ...) inside execute without quoting or parameter binding. A value containing a single quote breaks the SQL literal, causing a syntax error that aborts the migration (and introduces SQL injection).

findings.claim: EmbeddableHost's before_validation calls self.host.sub! without a nil guard. A missing host raises NoMethodError (500) instead of producing a validation error.

verifier.reason: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb:5-8, the before_validation callback calls self.host.sub! without checking for nil, so validating or saving a record with a nil host raises NoMethodError before validates_format_of runs. In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:23-30, omitting params[:embeddable_host][:host] assigns nil to host.host and triggers this NoMethodError (500) during host.save instead of returning render_json_error(host).

findings.claim: Admin::EmbeddingController#update persists nothing and only re-renders show. The PUT customize/embedding route and the client saveChanges action that back it are therefore dead.

verifier.reason: Admin::EmbeddingController#update (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:9-11) persists nothing and is identical to #show (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:5-7), only re-rendering @embedding. Consequently, the route put "customize/embedding" (config/routes.rb:139) and the client saveChanges action calling update({}) (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6:5-7, unreferenced in app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs:1-14) are dead code.

findings.claim: The new create/update/destroy and embedding show endpoints have no behavioural tests. The specs only assert subclassing of AdminController.

verifier.reason: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController defines create, update, and destroy (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:5-18) and Admin::EmbeddingController defines show and update (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb:5-11), but both spec/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb:5-7 and spec/controllers/admin/embedding_controller_spec.rb:5-7 only assert subclassing of Admin::AdminController with no behavioural tests for any action.

findings.claim: Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy use EmbeddableHost.where(id:).first and then call methods on the result. An unknown id raises NoMethodError (500) instead of returning 404.

verifier.reason: In app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:9-18, #update and #destroy query EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first without a nil check and then call host.host= (line 23, via save_host on line 11) and host.destroy (line 16). An unknown id returns nil and raises an unhandled NoMethodError (500) instead of a 404.

findings.claim: The host validation regex's [a-z]{2,5} TLD rule rejects localhost, IP addresses and TLDs longer than 5 characters such as .museum. Migrated rows that skipped validation then fail on later edit.

verifier.reason: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:2 validates :host with /\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i, which requires a dot followed by 2-5 ASCII letters and therefore rejects localhost, IP addresses, and TLDs longer than 5 characters such as .museum. Because Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update calls host.save with validations (app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:9-12,27), any migrated row with such a host fails validation on later edit.

findings.claim: The singleton embedding record is fetched with store.find without an id, which resolves to a collection.

verifier.reason: Although app/assets/javascripts/admin/routes/admin-embedding.js.es6:3 calls this.store.find('embedding') without an id, Discourse's Store#find in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6:64-73 only returns a _resultSet collection when typeof findArgs === "object". When findArgs is omitted (undefined), it takes the else branch at line 70 and calls self._hydrate(type, result[Ember.String.underscore(type)], result), resolving to a single hydrated embedding record fetched via app/assets/javascripts/admin/adapters/embedding.js.es6:4-6.
